records.officialName: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan Yojana

benefit.summary: Assured monthly pension after 60, with spouse and joint enrolment options
benefit.amountNote: Rs 3,000 per month from age 60; the spouse receives 50% of the pension after the beneficiary's death; a couple both enrolled receives Rs 6,000 per month jointly. Contribution slabs were not verified.

eligibilityConditions.text: Indian citizen
Unorganised worker (street vendor, agriculture, construction, leather, handloom, mid-day meal, rickshaw, rag picking, carpenter, fisherfolk and similar)
Aged 18 to 40 years
Monthly income below Rs 15,000 and not a member of EPFO, ESIC or a government-funded NPS

unresolvedQuestions: The contribution slabs and the 50% matching contribution need a primary PM-SYM page or notification; only the eligibility text was confirmed.

statusHistory.note: M9 evidence audit: official eligibility text added

records.name: Rythu Bharosa
records.benefitSummary: Investment support of Rs 6,000 per acre per crop season, paid by DBT.

benefit.summary: Direct income support to meet agricultural input costs
benefit.amountNote: Rs 6,000 per acre per season; Rs 12,000 per acre per year across Kharif and Rabi

eligibilityConditions.text: Resident of Telangana
Small or marginal farmer, tenant farmer leasing agricultural land, or agricultural labourer
Aged 18 to 59 years
Owns or leases agriculturally suitable land

exclusions: Mining areas, industrial zones and real estate land are not eligible
documents: Land ownership certificate or lease documents
records.applicationNotes: The district page describes an online application and status route on the scheme portal, with Gram Panchayat follow-up. The portal itself was not exercised for this research.
unresolvedQuestions: The district page states 18 to 59 years; confirm against the current Agriculture Department order.
Whether the per-acre amount changed in the 2025-26 or 2026-27 budget.
The district page says landless agricultural labourers are eligible while also requiring land ownership or a lease; that contradiction needs the scheme guideline.
records.notes: M9.1 audit: the per-acre figure was removed from the structured amount field (it is per acre, not per beneficiary) and verification downgraded to partial because the conditions come from a district summary, not the scheme guideline.

records.name: Indiramma Indlu
records.benefitSummary: Rs 5 lakh construction assistance and 250 square yards of land for landless beneficiaries.

benefit.summary: 100% subsidy to build a permanent house on one's own plot
benefit.amountNote: Rs 5 lakh construction assistance; 250 square yards of land for landless beneficiaries

eligibilityConditions.text: Landless or homeless family in Telangana
Constructs a permanent house on the beneficiary's own plot, or on land provided under the scheme

records.applicationNotes: The district page names the Indiramma Indlu portal as the application route; officials record progress in a mobile application.
unresolvedQuestions: No official income limit or selection order was found on the page.
Whether the older 2BHK Dignity Housing programme still runs alongside this scheme.

relationships.note: both are state housing programmes; no merger

records.name: Rajiv Yuva Vikasam
records.department: Welfare corporations for SC, ST, BC, Minority and EBC/EWS communities, Government of Telangana
records.benefitSummary: Loan-linked self-employment support up to Rs 4 lakh unit cost, with subsidy slabs up to 100%.

benefit.summary: Bank loan with a government subsidy for a self-employment venture
benefit.amountNote: District pages state assistance up to Rs 3 lakh. The guideline's unit-cost slabs are: 100% subsidy up to Rs 50,000; 90% up to Rs 1 lakh; 80% up to Rs 2 lakh; 70% up to Rs 4 lakh; minor irrigation 100%.

eligibilityConditions.text: Unemployed youth from SC, ST, BC, Minority and EBC/EWS communities
Aged 21 to 55 years for non-agricultural schemes, 21 to 60 for agriculture and allied sectors
Annual family income within Rs 1.5 lakh in rural areas or Rs 2 lakh in urban areas
Only one self-employment scheme per household within five years

exclusions: A household that received a self-employment scheme in the previous five years
documents: Caste certificate issued after Telangana formation
Permanent driving licence for transport sector schemes
SADAREM certificate for persons with disabilities
records.applicationNotes: Applications were registered on the TGOBMMS portal from 15 March to 14 April 2025, then submitted at Mandal Praja Palana Seva Kendralu in rural areas or the Municipal Commissioner office in urban areas. tgobmmsnew.cgg.gov.in did not respond when checked on 2026-11-27.
unresolvedQuestions: Whether a new application window has opened since 14 April 2025.
Whether the Rs 3 lakh figure quoted by district pages is the loan or the total unit cost.
The guideline PDF is a government-hosted copy; confirm it is the final approved version.
records.notes: M9.1 audit: the application portal did not respond, so the URL was moved out of applicationUrl.

records.name: Aasara Pensions
records.benefitSummary: Monthly social security pension for old age, widows, disability and listed worker categories.

benefit.amountNote: Rs 2,016 per month for old age, widows, weavers, toddy tappers, HIV-AIDS, beedi workers, single women and filaria patients; Rs 3,016 for persons with disabilities. The state Socio Economic Outlook 2021 confirms these amounts since June 2019; the current rate is unconfirmed.

eligibilityConditions.text: Old age pension: aged 57 years and above (the age limit was reduced from 65; the CAG audit covering 2018-21 still tabulates 65)
Widow pension: aged 18 years and above
Disability pension: any age, with 40% disability (51% for hearing impairment)
Weavers aged 50 and above; toddy tappers aged 50 and above who are members of a toddy tappers cooperative society
Beedi workers above 18 who began beedi rolling before 28 February 2014
Single women: separated or deserted for more than a year; unmarried rural women above 30 and urban women above 35

exclusions: Household annual income above Rs 1.5 lakh in rural areas or Rs 2 lakh in urban areas
Landholding above 3 acres wet or 7.5 acres dry
records.applicationNotes: District pages direct applicants to the Aasara portal, but aasara.telangana.gov.in did not respond when checked on 2026-11-27. Until that is confirmed, apply through the MeeSeva centre or the DRDA/MPDO office named in the 2014 order.
unresolvedQuestions: The old-age age limit is 57 in the 2021 state outlook but 65 in the CAG table for 2018-21; the current Government Order is needed.
The pension amount is a 2019 figure; confirm the current rate.
The Aasara portal did not respond at audit; confirm the current application route.
Exclusions beyond income and land (children in employment, four-wheeler owners, government pensioners) come from the CAG summary and are not recorded as separate fields.

relationships.note: Aasara includes a single women category; the separate record was not researched

records.notes: M9.1 audit: old-age age corrected from 65 to 57, verification downgraded to partial, the unreachable 2019 GO URL marked GONE, and the application URL removed because it did not respond.

records.name: Kalyana Lakshmi
records.benefitSummary: One-time marriage assistance of Rs 1,00,116 for eligible brides.

benefit.amountNote: One-time assistance, raised from Rs 75,116 on 19 March 2018

eligibilityConditions.text: Unmarried girl who is a resident of Telangana
Aged 18 years or above at the time of marriage
Belongs to SC, ST, BC or EBC
Parental annual income within Rs 2 lakh for SC and ST, and within Rs 2 lakh urban or Rs 1.5 lakh rural for BC and EBC
Marriage on or after 2 October 2014

records.applicationNotes: Applications are registered on the Telangana ePASS Kalyana Lakshmi service. The ePASS notice asks applicants to update the bride's mother's bank account details for verification.
unresolvedQuestions: Sources disagree on the amount for disabled girls; the higher figure seen on a non-official aggregator is not recorded.
Whether the BC/EBC rural income limit of Rs 1.5 lakh is still current.

records.name: Shaadi Mubarak

eligibilityConditions.text: Unmarried girl belonging to a minority community
Resident of Telangana
Aged 18 years or above at the time of marriage
Family annual income within Rs 2 lakh

records.applicationNotes: Registered through the Telangana ePASS Shaadi Mubarak service alongside Kalyana Lakshmi.
unresolvedQuestions: The separate benefit amount for Shaadi Mubarak is not stated in the sources read.
Whether the minority income limit is Rs 2 lakh with no rural/urban split.

One-time assistance per family

Whether the scheme is open statewide or continues constituency-wise.

benefit.summary: Maternity kit for the mother and newborn
benefit.amountNote: 16 types of articles worth about Rs 2,000, per the district page

records.name: Mahalakshmi
records.benefitSummary: Rs 2,500 a month for women heads of family, LPG cylinders at Rs 500 and free TSRTC bus travel.

benefit.amountNote: Rs 2,500 per month for women heads of family; domestic LPG at Rs 500 per cylinder; free travel on TSRTC Palle Velugu and Express buses

eligibilityConditions.text: Woman who is the head of her family and a resident of Telangana

Free bus travel: all women, girls and transgender persons with a valid Aadhaar card

Whether the LPG subsidy is per cylinder with no annual cap.
